body: From services to neighborhood news, DC.gov is your official and trusted source for what's happening in the District.

It's a great day in the District!

Mayor Muriel Bowser, serving since 2015, is dedicated to making DC a city of opportunity for all. Her leadership focuses on safety, education, economic growth, and ensuring residents are healthy, housed, and connected.
